The Asus Vivobook 16" I7-13620H is a powerhouse laptop designed for both work and play. With its Intel® Core™ i7 processor, vivid 16" display, and ample storage, it delivers exceptional performance and stunning visuals, making it perfect for professionals and gamers alike.

Key Features

  • Powerful Processor: Equipped with Intel® Core™ i7-13620H for seamless multitasking and high-speed performance.
  • Vivid Display: 16" FHD display offering stunning visuals and vibrant colors.
  • Ample Storage: 512GB M.2 NVMe™ PCIe® 4.0 SSD for fast data access and storage.
  • Enhanced Connectivity: Features Bluetooth 5.3 and multiple USB ports for versatile connectivity.
  • Security Features: Includes a fingerprint sensor for secure login.
  • Portable Design: Lightweight at 1.68 kg, making it easy to carry around.

Product Specifications

Specifications:

  • Processor

  • Storage
    • 512GB M.2 NVMe™ PCIe® 4.0 SSD
  • Graphics
    • Intel® UHD Graphics
  • Connectivity
    • Bluetooth 5.3 (Dual Band)
    • 1x USB 2.0 Type-A, 1x USB 3.2 (Gen 1) Type-C with support for power delivery
    • 1x HDMI 1.4
  • Web Camera
    • 720p HD camera with privacy shutter
  • Security
    • Fingerprint Sensor
  • Weight
    • 1.68 kg
  • Dimensions
    • 24.95 x 1.99 x 35.87 cm

Ideal For

The ASUS Vivobook 16" I7-13620H is ideal for tech-savvy individuals, professionals, and gamers who demand high performance and sleek design in a laptop.

  • McAfee 1 Year Subscription
